title: SELECT WHERE ORDER BY
objective: WHERE reduces the candidate rows; ORDER BY establishes deterministic order, especially important for paging and test assertions.
misconception: The starter sorts all tasks, including a different tenant and completed work, instead of finding alpha's open tasks.
acceptance: Explain why an ORDER BY inside a view is not a reliable contract for clients querying that view. Apply ORDER BY in the final consuming SELECT, and add a unique tie-breaker to pagination.
securityBoundary: Without a tenant and status predicate, even correctly sorted rows can disclose unrelated tasks.
